## Context

A guessed pin assignment did not match the datasheet.

## Options

- Keep guessing and fix in review
- Require every pin assignment to quote the datasheet

## Choice

Quote the datasheet.

## Why

Invented pinouts fail in hardware; the datasheet row is the source of truth.
